adc3bbd04b39dfd993f8483a7b6dacf2c4304a65.summary: Sekoia Threat Detection & Research reports on FakeBat, a malware-as-a-service loader sold since December 2022 by Eugenfest (aka Payk_34), with a paid distribution service. Its 2024 distribution clusters include malvertising that impersonates legitimate software, fake browser updates injected into several hundred compromised WordPress sites, and social-engineering lures aimed at web3 users. The report tracks FakeBat C2 infrastructure since August 2023 and names more than 130 associated domains. It also notes other drive-by clusters linked to FIN7, UNC4696 and BatLoader.
